definitions.explanation: A real bullet or shell, as opposed to a blank or a training round.

examples.japanese: {実弾|じつだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発射|はっしゃ}する→発射する：21027_hasshasuru⟧。
⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{実弾|じつだん}⟦{射撃|しゃげき}→射撃：16089_shageki⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The Self-Defense Forces held a live-fire exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拳銃|けんじゅう}→拳銃：16266_kenjuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実弾|じつだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{込|こ}められている→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{細心|さいしん}→細心：31288_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Police officers' pistols are loaded with live rounds, so they must be handled with the utmost care.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実弾|じつだん}⟦{射撃|しゃげき}→射撃：16089_shageki⟧: live firing
- {実弾|じつだん}⟦{演習|えんしゅう}→演習：13363_enshuu⟧: a live-fire exercise
- {実弾|じつだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to load live rounds

WATCH OUT:
In political slang {実弾|じつだん} means cash handed out to buy votes or favors (⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{実弾|じつだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}び{交|か}う→飛び交う：31631_tobikau⟧, "cash was flying around in the election"). Context makes it clear; outside elections and bribery stories, it means bullets.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空砲|くうほう}: a blank (cartridge with no bullet)
